decision.observation: 5:30 pm, Sat. 6; the rod is raised with the bobber near the tip (~0.61,0.25), cast in flight; pond directly below the farmer.
decision.hypothesis: The bobber will land in the pond; then a dip/'HIT!' will come and pressing C at it catches a fish.
